title: Director of Operations
text:
Job description:

Job Overview

We are seeking a dynamic and energetic Operations Manager to lead and optimize daily store operations, ensuring a seamless shopping experience for customers and a motivating environment for team members. This role requires a proactive leader with strong management skills, excellent communication abilities, and a passion for retail excellence. As an Operations Manager, you will oversee all aspects of store functions, from sales and customer service to inventory control and staff supervision, driving operational efficiency and sales growth.

Duties

* Lead and manage the retail team, including hiring, training, coaching, and developing staff to achieve high performance standards.
* Oversee daily store operations such as cash handling, POS system management, merchandising, stocking, and inventory control to ensure accuracy and efficiency.
* Implement effective sales strategies by managing pricing, promotions, and product placement to maximize revenue.
* Supervise shift management activities, including scheduling, task delegation, and ensuring excellent customer service at all times.
* Conduct employee orientation sessions, interviews for new hires, and ongoing training to foster a knowledgeable and motivated team.
* Manage purchasing decisions, vendor relations, and inventory replenishment to maintain optimal stock levels while controlling costs.
* Enforce safety protocols, manage payroll processing, bookkeeping tasks, and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Utilize management skills to analyze sales data, prepare budgets, monitor expenses, and identify opportunities for operational improvements.

Experience

* Proven managerial experience in retail store management or a similar leadership role within the retail industry.
* Demonstrated success in supervising sales teams with a focus on retail sales management and customer service excellence.
* Strong background in inventory management, POS systems operation, merchandising, and cash handling procedures.
* Experience in recruiting, interviewing, onboarding new employees, and conducting training & development initiatives.
* Knowledge of retail math including pricing strategies, budgeting techniques, and basic financial analysis.
* Bilingual or multilingual skills are highly desirable to effectively communicate with diverse customer bases.
* Previous experience with grocery or wireless sales environments is a plus; familiarity with retail industry standards is essential.

Join us as an Operations Manager to lead with energy and purpose! Your leadership will inspire your team to deliver outstanding customer experiences while driving operational success. We value proactive problem-solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments — if you’re passionate about retail management and ready to make an impact, we want to hear from you!

Pay: $80,000.00 - $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan

Work Location: In person
